connector.name: MCP by florentine-ai
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Florentine.ai - Natural language to MongoDB aggregations
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the florentine-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FLORENTINE_TOKEN
env.description: Your Florentine.ai API key, get it from https://florentine.ai/dashboard

env.name: LLM_SERVICE
env.description: The LLM service to use, one of 'openai', 'anthropic', 'google' or 'deepseek' (must only be provided if you did not set it in your Florentine.ai account)

env.name: LLM_KEY
env.description: Your API key for the LLM service (must only be provided if you did not set it in your Florentine.ai account)

env.name: SESSION_ID
env.description: Session ID for maintaining server-side context across requests

env.name: RETURN_TYPES
env.description: Stringified JSON array of return types for the response

env.name: REQUIRED_INPUTS
env.description: Stringified JSON array of values for required inputs keys
